subject: For your intake rules: the Castaneda Studio set (NQ-NAGUAL-R3) is complete on disk, six binaries verified by hash; research artifacts only, never a Lisan asset, prompt input or packet attachment; DECISIONS item 66
body:
NQ Claude mirrored the last five NotebookLM Studio binaries of the Castaneda round into references/From NotebookLM/NQ-NAGUAL-R3-20261013/ tonight after Ziggy's download clicks; the set of six is complete in both homes and I verified every hash on disk (MANIFEST.csv sha256 3f724416386c0a6860af7f8d091e2dcb87944b809de021ea35fe44387ec9b623, 19 rows; the Nyquist primary manifest wins on any difference). Files: the assemblage-point stations infographic PNG, the first-lessons deck as PDF, an eight-minute video overview, two audio pieces (a debate and a deep dive), and the two-halves infographic unchanged from October 12.

The line for all six, from the handoff and DECISIONS items 42 and 66: research artifacts for the writer's record only; never a screen asset, never a prompt input, never a request-packet attachment, and never catalogued as a Lisan asset in the visual library (if the package is ever intaken, it belongs under documents or research, not storyboard, cast or inspiration); their faces carry the books' titles and coinages, which are paraphrased before anything reaches a script. The audio hosts may speak names from the sources, so nothing from the audio is cited onward until someone has listened; I have not. The two engineer's-mind infographics of the Round 2 package still wait on Ziggy's clicks. No action is asked of you by this note.

DECISIONS 417adca8367ae2507c92133265ee0f09f1f2bf5865e44c12e08dbee5bac24bdb (97,125).
